entries.86c53463b3ca331f: This is a business launched as a new pillar that combines the knowledge gained in both the real estate brokerage and office interior businesses. It aims to increase the asset value of building owners and the convenience of tenants.
entries.8b2689285bb351ff: Interior construction and office space construction
entries.8e62e0cde457b362: It provides office interior construction and services incidental to it. The consolidated subsidiary Daiichi Kogeisha Inc. is engaged in next-generation office space consulting. Revenue from interior construction and services incidental to it for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,333 million.
entries.9015b93afb169a70: It arranges the development of various infrastructure associated with relocation and the procurement of office equipment and furniture.
entries.9aa3c881cd8ffe9a: This is a business that provides comprehensive support at the time of office relocation, when companies' needs for solutions are at their highest, from real estate brokerage and interior construction to the arrangement of various infrastructure and office equipment and furniture. It is a single segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,563 million.
